The '''Kesh system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], where the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] was isolated in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="Precipice" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Kesh in the M-21 grid square, while [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] later placed it in U-10. [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', confirmed that U-10 is correct and explained that Kesh was placed in the ''Atlas'' incorrectly because it was published before the storytelling around Kesh was complete.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023 3.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-04-12}}</ref>
